error: Counts the starting number as the first step.
shows: Off-by-one counting.
example: 6 + 2: wrong 7, correct 8.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: one priority letter in the next 5-minute Warm-up and repair. Tap the cover; hold the start, then move once per new count. Fewer misses: 5-minute group within practice. End results: day 17 A/B/C, day 18 D/E/F/G/H.

error: Gives the ending count word as the subtraction answer.
shows: Confuses the endpoint with the number of steps.
example: 18 - 13: wrong 18, correct 5 steps.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: one priority letter in the next 5-minute Warm-up and repair. Draw one dot per step from 13 to 18 and count the dots. Fewer misses: 5-minute group within practice. End results: day 17 A/B/C, day 18 D/E/F/G/H.

error: Recounts the whole starting group when asked to count on.
shows: Counted quantity is not held intact.
example: 4 + 4: starts at one; right holds 4 and counts 5, 6, 7, 8.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: one priority letter in the next 5-minute Warm-up and repair. Name the start, cover it, then count the new counters. Fewer misses: 5-minute group within practice. End results: day 17 A/B/C, day 18 D/E/F/G/H.

error: Places one response in two categories.
shows: Overlapping membership.
example: 10 shapes, one square in two groups gives 11 marks; right gives 10.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: one priority letter in the next 5-minute Warm-up and repair. Move each object onto exactly one category mat. Fewer misses: 5-minute group within practice. End results: day 17 A/B/C, day 18 D/E/F/G/H.

error: Leaves a response out.
shows: One-to-one tracking is lost.
example: Five slips with only four marks; right has five marks.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: one priority letter in the next 5-minute Warm-up and repair. Tick each slip as its single mark is drawn. Fewer misses: 5-minute group within practice. End results: day 17 A/B/C, day 18 D/E/F/G/H.

error: Gives the larger category count as how many more or fewer.
shows: Group count confused with unmatched count.
example: Rug 9, beanbag 4: wrong 9 more, correct 5.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: one priority letter in the next 5-minute Warm-up and repair. Match one-to-one and count only unmatched marks. Fewer misses: 5-minute group within practice. End results: day 17 A/B/C, day 18 D/E/F/G/H.

error: Omits category labels.
shows: Reader cannot identify the groups.
example: Unlabeled columns beside picture-labeled columns.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: one priority letter in the next 5-minute Warm-up and repair. Draw one category picture above each group. Fewer misses: 5-minute group within practice. End results: day 17 A/B/C, day 18 D/E/F/G/H.

error: Counts categories instead of all responses.
shows: Groups confused with data points.
example: Rabbits 5, hamsters 3, birds 1: wrong total 3, correct 9.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: one priority letter in the next 5-minute Warm-up and repair. Touch each response mark exactly once across all groups. Fewer misses: 5-minute group within practice. End results: day 17 A/B/C, day 18 D/E/F/G/H.

error: Rejects a true equation when the total comes first.
shows: Treats equals as a direction to give an answer.
example: 7 = 5 + 2: wrong false, right true.
if_many: If more than ten of thirty miss, use one priority letter in the next five-minute Practice return; otherwise confer in a small group. Match both amounts and read the equation both ways. Use a fresh paper retry. End-of-unit evidence returns on day 40.

error: Ignores part or all of the second expression.
shows: Checks only one side or one number.
example: 3 + 2 = 5 + 1: wrong true, right false.
if_many: If more than ten of thirty miss, use one priority letter in the next five-minute Practice return; otherwise confer in a small group. Make both sides in separate workspaces before comparing. Use a fresh paper retry. End-of-unit evidence returns on day 40.

error: Reports the end quantity as the change.
shows: Identifies the wrong story quantity.
example: 7 + □ = 17: wrong 17, right 10.
if_many: If more than ten of thirty miss, use one priority letter in the next five-minute Practice return; otherwise confer in a small group. Hold the start still and ring just the moved group. Use a fresh paper retry. End-of-unit evidence returns on day 41.

error: Adds the known whole and part to find a missing part.
shows: Treats the whole as another part.
example: 17 and 5: wrong 22, right 12.
if_many: If more than ten of thirty miss, use one priority letter in the next five-minute Practice return; otherwise confer in a small group. Cover the known part within the whole and mark the rest. Use a fresh paper retry. End-of-unit evidence returns on day 41.

error: Reports the larger group count as the difference.
shows: Confuses a full group with the extra.
example: Unit contrast: 10 and 6; wrong 10, right 4.
if_many: If more than ten of thirty miss, use one priority letter in the next five-minute Practice return; otherwise confer in a small group. Pair one to one and ring only marks with no partner. Use a fresh paper retry. End-of-unit evidence returns on day 41.

error: Subtracts the removed amount from the result to find the start.
shows: Reverses the relationship.
example: 15 = □ - 2: wrong 13, right 17.
if_many: If more than ten of thirty miss, use one priority letter in the next five-minute Practice return; otherwise confer in a small group. Restore the removed pieces to the remaining group. Use a fresh paper retry. End-of-unit evidence returns on day 40.

error: Chooses two parts that change the fixed whole.
shows: Loses the whole while splitting.
example: Whole 7: wrong 5 and 3, right 5 and 2.
if_many: If more than ten of thirty miss, use one priority letter in the next five-minute Practice return; otherwise confer in a small group. Move each of the original pieces into exactly one part. Use a fresh paper retry. End-of-unit evidence returns on day 41.

error: Counts the start as the first added step.
shows: Makes an off-by-one count.
example: 2 + 3: wrong 4, right 5.
if_many: If more than ten of thirty miss, use one priority letter in the next five-minute Practice return; otherwise confer in a small group. Hold the start and touch one new piece per new count. Use a fresh paper retry. End-of-unit evidence returns on day 41.

error: Adds pieces that are removed.
shows: Reverses the story's action.
example: 6 - 1: wrong 7, right 5.
if_many: If more than ten of thirty miss, use one priority letter in the next five-minute Practice return; otherwise confer in a small group. Cross out only departing pieces and count those still there. Use a fresh paper retry. End-of-unit evidence returns on day 41.

error: Counts the starting quantity as the first added step.
shows: Treats the held amount as a new count.
example: 2 + 8: hold eight and count nine, ten. The puppet counts eight and nine and gives nine.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: use one priority repair at the named return, with a fresh case. Hold the start, then tap once per new piece. Fewer: meet the small group during practice. Mid-unit response day 58; closing response days 69 and 70.

error: Counts a ten-stick as one one.
shows: Loses the value of the tens unit.
example: A stick and eight singles show eighteen. The puppet calls them nine.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: use one priority repair at the named return, with a fresh case. Open a ten strip, touch all ten marks, then match it to the same ones after refolding. Fewer: meet the small group during practice. Mid-unit response day 58; closing response days 69 and 70.

error: Reuses the whole addend after moving part to make ten.
shows: Counts moved pieces twice.
example: 6 + 5: move four and leave one. The puppet moves four and still adds all five to ten.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: use one priority repair at the named return, with a fresh case. Circle the moved amount and point to the remaining part before writing the sum. Fewer: meet the small group during practice. Mid-unit response day 58; closing response days 69 and 70.

error: Omits an addend from a three-addend sum.
shows: Loses an intact group during regrouping.
example: 1 + 9 + 4: ten and four make fourteen. The puppet stops at ten.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: use one priority repair at the named return, with a fresh case. Touch each group as its term is read and locate it in the changed arrangement. Fewer: meet the small group during practice. Mid-unit response day 58; closing response days 69 and 70.

error: Reverses subtraction as though it were addition.
shows: Applies addition order to a removal.
example: Seven take away two leaves five. Trying to take seven from two runs out of pieces.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: use one priority repair at the named return, with a fresh case. Build each start separately and try each removal with its own pieces. Fewer: meet the small group during practice. Mid-unit response day 58; closing response days 69 and 70.

error: Gives the final quantity as the missing change.
shows: Uses the group that stays for the group that leaves.
example: 17 − □ = 12: five leave and twelve stay. The puppet labels the change twelve.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: use one priority repair at the named return, with a fresh case. Mark only the departing pieces and point from them to the unknown box. Fewer: meet the small group during practice. Mid-unit response day 58; closing response days 69 and 70.

error: Subtracts the whole amount again after removing part of it.
shows: Fails to preserve the total removal.
example: Nineteen loses four, leaving fifteen. The puppet takes two, then four more, leaving thirteen.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: use one priority repair at the named return, with a fresh case. Split the removal into two parts, mark each once, then check that together they equal the request. Fewer: meet the small group during practice. Mid-unit response day 58; closing response days 69 and 70.

error: Copies a known fact answer after a quantity changes.
shows: Keeps a prior result without tracking the changed part.
example: 4 + 4 makes eight. One more joins, so 4 + 5 makes nine. The puppet keeps eight.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: use one priority repair at the named return, with a fresh case. Point to the extra or missing piece, then adjust the answer once. Fewer: meet the small group during practice. Mid-unit response day 58; closing response days 69 and 70.

error: Subtracts a known removal from the result to find the start.
shows: Treats the result as the original whole.
example: □ − 2 = 7: restore two to seven, making nine. The puppet gives five.
if_many: More than 10 of 30: use one priority repair at the named return, with a fresh case. Restore the removed group to the survivors and check by acting the original removal. Fewer: meet the small group during practice. Mid-unit response day 58; closing response days 69 and 70.
